scope.population: Previously exposed fixed48 validation engineering records only.

matching.distance_method: Maximum of six exact Fraction symmetric folds; no summed or timing-based distance
matching.zero_policy: 0/0 fold is 1; one-sided zero excludes the candidate from all matching and nearest sets
matching.nearest_policy: All eligible minimum-distance ties are retained; nearest does not relax either threshold
matching.interpretation: Profiles use anonymous one-based positions and relative numeric folds only. Similar selection fields do not control diagnostic fields or establish equal elapsed cost.

interpretation: Peers are selected from the other 46 positions using logical workload only, never timing. Primary 5/4 and expanded 3/2 symmetric-fold rules retain all matches. Nonmatching nearest positions are not relabeled as comparable. Timing is the saved V50 query charge: verification plus append excluding commit plus in-query commit; tail commit and warmups are excluded. Positive means V46 took longer. Peer median is computed within each of the six pairs before subtracting from the target. MAD is unscaled. The 1 ms band and workload bounds are descriptive, not significance tests. Six pairs repeat the same queries and peer sets may overlap. Fixed query order makes these different time positions, not simultaneous controls; subtraction does not remove host-load or other confounding. Bit width and catalog size are disclosed diagnostics, not matching criteria. There is no causal claim about the decoder, CPU, I/O or scheduling, and no generalization to unseen data. Targets and records were already exposed in V50/V51; freezing peer rules now does not make this a new confirmatory experiment.
